$comment: T-2.47: which world and body sounds play when. A round passing within `nearMiss.distanceM` of your head plays `crack` at the point it passed nearest (so it is heard on that side) and `whiz` there too. An impact plays by what it struck. An explosion within `explosion.farM` plays its near version and beyond it the far one. A footstep plays by stance on each foot's contact in the gait; a landing after `landing.minAirSeconds` in the air plays `land`.
